review.fitness_expert_summary: This chest workout has serious issues: two Single Arm Floor Press variations back-to-back (redundant movement pattern), several obscure/unclear exercises, and lacks appropriate push:pull balance or rear delt work for a 64-year-old intermediate. The exercise selection appears random rather than following compound-to-isolation progression.
review.product_engineer_summary: Multiple filtering failures: duplicate movement patterns weren't caught, obscure exercises like 'Lateral Hit' and 'Chest Fly & Press Up' made it through, and the balance slot enforcement didn't add rear delt work. The exercise database needs cleanup and the SmartExerciseSelectionEngine needs better redundancy detection.

issues.description: Duplicate Single Arm Floor Press pattern with exercise index 1 (kettlebell version) - redundant unilateral pressing movement.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add movement pattern deduplication in SmartExercisePairingEngine to prevent same exercise with different equipment in one workout.

issues.description: Unclear exercise name 'Lateral Hit' - not a standard chest movement and confusing for users.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'Lateral Hit' from FoundationalExerciseDatabase or clarify as 'Lateral Chest Fly' if that's the intended movement.

issues.description: Non-standard compound exercise name - unclear if it's a fly-to-pushup combination or separate movements.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace with standard 'Push-Up' or 'Chest Fly' in FoundationalExerciseDatabase for clarity.

issues.description: Chest-focused workout lacks rear delt work for push:pull balance, especially important for 64-year-old posture health.
issues.fix_suggestion: Enforce balance slot in WorkoutComboRules - add rear delt exercise when chest volume exceeds threshold on push days.

issues.description: Barbell pullover can stress shoulders in overhead position for 64-year-old - dumbbell version would be safer.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add age >= 60 filter to prefer dumbbell over barbell for pullover movements in SmartExerciseSelectionEngine.

improvement_suggestions.title: Add movement pattern deduplication in workout generation
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Two Single Arm Floor Press variations in one workout wastes slots and provides no additional training stimulus - the engine should detect and prevent this redundancy.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: SmartExercisePairingEngine.swift - add movement pattern tracking in generateWorkoutCombination()

improvement_suggestions.title: Clean up obscure exercise names in database
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Exercises like 'Lateral Hit' and 'Chest Fly & Press Up' confuse users and don't follow standard nomenclature - clear naming improves user experience and safety.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: FoundationalExerciseDatabase.swift - audit and standardize all exercise names to match common gym terminology

improvement_suggestions.title: Enforce balance slot requirement for push-dominant workouts
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Chest workouts without rear delt work create muscle imbalances, especially problematic for older users who need postural support.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: WorkoutComboRules.swift - add mandatory rear delt slot when push volume > 4 exercises
